question: Shipment SH-2060 (Vaccine A, lot L-A-04) logged 22 min at a max of 10.1 C today. Release, quarantine, destroy or escalate?
context:
- Shipment SH-2060: Vaccine A (multi-dose vial) (PRD-A, freeze-sensitive: yes), lot L-A-04, carrier CR-1 Bluefin Courier.
- Excursion EXC-2060 on 2026-10-15: 22 min, max 10.1 C, min 4.9 C.
- Policy in force on 2026-10-15: SOP-TEMP-v3 (it SUPERSEDES SOP-TEMP-v2, which no longer applies). Rule: Apply in order. Step 1: freeze-sensitive product with any reading at or below 0.0 C -> DESTROY, no exceptions. Step 2: max at most 12.0 C AND at most 30 min AND the lot has at least 60 min of stability budget left before this excursion -> RELEASE (deduct the minutes from the lot budget). Step 3: anything else -> QUARANTINE pending QA review.
- Lot L-A-04 stability budget: 100 min. Already used: 40 min by DEC-135, 25 min by DEC-142. Left BEFORE this excursion: 35 min (Step 2 needs 60).
- Precedent DEC-135 (2026-07-03, about L-A-04): RELEASE, still valid. Outcome OUT-136: No complaints; stock used before expiry.
- Precedent DEC-142 (2026-09-12, about SH-2031): RELEASE, still valid.
- Precedent DEC-131 (2026-06-10, about SH-1975): RELEASE, still valid. Outcome OUT-132: Potency retest passed; no complaints after 60 days.
- Precedent DEC-141 (2026-09-19, about SH-2044): RELEASE, still valid.
- POL-SIGNOFF-01: An AI agent may propose a disposition. A human QA reviewer approves it before stock moves.
- SOP-TEMP-v3 checks answered from the graph: Step 1 condition (freeze-sensitive AND froze): no. Step 2 condition (max <= 12 C, <= 30 min, >= 60 min budget left): no (only 35 min budget left < 60). Overturned precedents to ignore: none. Active constraints: none.

answer.reason: The excursion exceeded the 35-minute stability budget, failing Step 2 of the policy.
